title: the 48 GB run's preflight and a quota row that is not listed

findings.claim: deploy/gcp/measure48-run.sh --preflight refused every launch (exit 4, HDB_TOTAL_GB quota not readable) because gcloud's region description lists 113 quota rows and none of them is HDB_TOTAL_GB
findings.severity_basis: a paid run blocked: no launch possible through the driver; nothing spent or harmed
findings.fix: an absent row is said in one line and the preflight goes on; a listed short row still refuses; --hdb-free-gb N gives the free figure by hand; a failed gcloud call or unparseable output still refuses; a refused create ends the launch with exit 5 after checking no VM is left; tests in tests/unit/test_measure48_run_h53.py
